roadmap_item: RI-UIX08 / the dialogue window's input path
could_not_do: FAULT 2 (character creation does not use this window) is NOT fixed yet. Diagnosis only so far.
Gamepad arm not driven: no pad shim wired in this probe. Scored 0 fail-closed per CRITIC-DOCTRINE 1.2b clause 4 until driven.

The first run of my own drive probe reported EVERY keyboard check FAIL. That was MY INSTRUMENT, not the game: '?harness=1' calls real.detach(), so DOM KeyboardEvents reached nothing. Fixed with setMode('play-instrumented') plus an I0 instrument check that must pass before any other result is believed.
headline: The keyboard/pad path was NEVER broken. MOUSE AND TOUCH WERE: there is no pointer path in ui/system.js at all (its own rule 2), so every drawn control in the dialogue window was inert to a click. The owner plays in a browser with a mouse.

measured_before_fix.probe: tools/ui/dialogue-drive-probe.mjs (real DOM KeyboardEvent/MouseEvent/PointerEvent, nothing calls a UI function)
measured_before_fix.keyboard: K1 ArrowRight prose->column PASS; K2 ArrowDown row 0->1 PASS; K3 KeyE answered, 1->6 lines PASS; K6 Goodbye closes PASS; K7 Space backs out PASS
measured_before_fix.mouse: M1 click a column topic: 2->2 lines, NO EFFECT. M3 click Goodbye: window open true->true, NO EFFECT.
measured_before_fix.touch: T1 tap a column topic: 2->2 lines, NO EFFECT.
measured_before_fix.other_dead_controls: K4 10/12 column rows answered. Dead: 'Persuasion' (disposition 69->69, no block); re-asking the topic that is already the last block appends nothing (DialogueHistory.append idempotency guard).

fix: game/src/ui/screens/dialogue.js: drawDialogue publishes a `hits` list built from the same rects the elements are declared with, plus `panel_rect`. Link rects padded toward the RI-UIX06 B4 touch floor without overlapping the next line.

game/src/ui/system.js: dialoguePointer(x,y,phase) hit-tests, moves the ONE caret, arms on press and confirms on release over the same control; dialogueStep consumes the confirm and routes it through the new _dialogueConfirm(), so mouse/touch/key/pad all decide the action in one place on a fixed step.
game/src/input/real.js: onSurfacePointer hook on mousedown/mouseup/mousemove, before Mouse0->light and before the pointer-lock request.
game/src/input/touch.js: onSurfacePointer hook in down()/up(), before _hitButton and before the stick claims the left half of the screen.
game/src/engine.js: _bindSurfacePointer() owns the client-px -> menus-canvas-px mapping in one place; _conversationSync releases pointer lock and sets pad.uiMode while a conversation is open.
next_step: Re-run tools/ui/dialogue-drive-probe.mjs; expect M1/M2/M3/T1 to pass. Then delete-the-fix. Then fault 2.

declared_overlap.W1-TOUCH-r2: claims input/real.js and input/touch.js. My edits there are TWO additive hook call sites each (onSurfacePointer), null everywhere except while a conversation is open. No existing branch changed.
declared_overlap.T4-r2-builder: live in game/src/ui/screens/. I do not touch screens/progress.js, screens/inventory.js or hud.js.
